findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: order_stack_check · Public sink: order_lint, order_audit, order_skill_scan_lite, order_escrow_red_flag_peek, order_session_snapshot, order_stack_check, order_production_harden, order_data_kondo, order_wrong_buy_remediation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: order_stack_check · Public sink: order_lint, order_audit, order_skill_scan_lite, order_escrow_red_flag_peek, order_session_snapshot, order_stack_check, order_production_harden, order_data_kondo, order_wrong_buy_remediation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
